name: Canada

latest_census.notes: 2021 Census of Population. Religion is asked once a decade (2021 yes, 2016 no; Religion Reference Guide 98-500-X2021016). 'Ethnic or cultural origin' is a multi-response write-in (2021 changes documented in 98-20-0002), so shares are of responses and exceed 100%; 'visible minority' is an Employment Equity Act category, and Indigenous identity is a separate question. Language: mother tongue, language spoken most often at home and knowledge of official languages. Religion, ethnic origin and visible minority are long-form (sample) questions; mother tongue is on the short form for everyone -- the profile still labels all of them as census counts. Ethnocultural and religious diversity release date 26 October 2022; census-division/subdivision tables 21 June 2023.

tier_reason: All three fields are census counts published in CSV for exactly the two geographies the boundary draws: 13 provinces/territories and 76 economic regions, in one Census Profile download (98-401-X2021008). The existing adapter reads the wrong admin2 (census divisions) through a per-geography REST call that has mostly failed, which is why admin2 is empty and 12 of 13 provinces lack religion.
recommended_action: Fetch the 'Canada, provinces, territories and economic regions' Census Profile CSV from the Downloads page and read religion, ethnic or cultural origin (multi-response: shares of responses, as Australia's ancestry is handled) and mother tongue for the 13 PTs and 76 ERs; join on ER code/DGUID (2021S0500xxxx) via the ER boundary file rather than on names, because the boundary's names are bilingual composites ('Southern / Sud', 'Vancouver Island and Coast / *'). This supersedes the single province filled by the REST adapter. Alternatively retarget statcan.py's GEOS to 'ER' if the geography-list endpoint is fixed. Keep visible minority separate from ethnicity, as the adapter's docstring already says.

summary: Canada's 2021 census asks religion, ethnic or cultural origin (multi-response) and mother tongue, and StatCan publishes all of them for provinces/territories (13) and economic regions (76) -- precisely the boundary's admin1 and admin2 -- in one downloadable Census Profile file, 98-401-X2021008. The repo's adapter reads census divisions (not the boundary's ERs) through a per-DGUID REST service that has mostly failed, leaving one province with religion and no admin2 at all; the ER CSV replaces that. Join on ER codes/DGUIDs from the 2021 ER boundary file, not on the bilingual composite names. Tables 98-10-0354-01 (religion) and 98-10-0357-01 (ethnic origin) exist at census-division level as a fallback with a CD-to-ER crosswalk.
